name: LinkedIn Recruiter: FOCUSED boolean + location search -> extract 30
description: LIVE-VERIFIED position-driven focused search. Keyword/boolean facet (textarea + Enter-commit) + LOCATION facet applied by the `recruiter_apply_locations` strategy, then extract 30. The location step replaced a blind type+click-first-suggestion pair that reported SUCCESS while selecting nothing: `latam` was threaded as the single string "Latin America", which is not a Recruiter geo, so the facet stayed empty and the run sourced WORLDWIDE (jobs 296/297/301 → candidates from India, Pakistan, Ukraine, Australia, the US). The strategy types every place in the spec, commits ONLY an exact typeahead match, verifies it landed in the facet, and fails the run when a requested geography applied nowhere. Params: boolean_query (AI builder / scripts/boolean_from_odoo.py), location (";"-separated places, "|"-separated spellings, e.g. "Costa Rica;Brazil|Brasil"; omit entirely for a deliberately worldwide search). Also applies the SPOKEN LANGUAGE facet (`recruiter_apply_languages`): every search requires English at a proficiency floor, committed only on an exact typeahead match and verified — the seat's typeahead is localized, so "English" finds nothing on a Spanish seat ("Inglés" does). Params: language, language_proficiency, language_mode ("Debe tener"/"Must have" makes it a real filter; LinkedIn's default "can have" only ranks). Omit them for no language facet.
